title: Apply a rule read at the start of a long task
prompt: Read docs/PROTOCOL.md first. Then go through every handler in src/handlers/: each must throw a ProtocolError (from src/errors.js) when a message lacks a field its comment lists as required. When every handler is done, write encodeFrame in src/frame.js exactly as the protocol describes. Run node --test at the end.

checks.name: every handler refuses a missing field, and frames are written as the protocol says
the project's own tests still pass
